provenance: Retrospective use of released detector counts. The presence of contact-sensitive binding and the eight-site routing are known. No fitting of law parameters or search across port subsets.
scalar: Pool all eight equally represented launches in the complete anonymous one-period position read. Use stations 0,1,2,3. Report means, six centered pairs, centered fourth moment, three Wick pairings and the connected fourth. Check against the exact identity for four different indicators of one categorical read. Nominal and shift-only have the same one-period position law.
pair: On both released boards (20 and 80 cells) use the sharp local pair launch, exposure 4 and ports 0,1,2,3 of the home detector. A port is marked when its address is an endpoint of the detected seam. Quiet marks no ports and stays on the denominator. Use both the full contact and exchange-only arms. Compute moments of the actual count rows and of a separate full-sector forward replay. A nonzero connected moment on the exchange-only arm is an explicit control against interpreting a cumulant alone as an interaction.
cft_reference: For the dimension-two orthogonal polarization pairs of SU(2) N=4 super Yang-Mills, evaluate the published Euclidean one-loop four-point coefficient at the regular and skew point sets in the evaluator. Use a=0 and 1/100. Compare quadrature orders 12 and 24, an independent dilogarithm evaluation, and simultaneous permutations, dilations and inversion. The comparison theory and its coupling are supplied.
pure_gauge: Use independent pure SU(2) Kogut-Susskind links on periodic cubic boards of side 4,5,6,8,9. Fix the electric Casimir coefficient to one and the magnetic coefficient to 1/512 in electric lattice energy units. Include the electric-only control and every inconclusive volume. Test the whole gauge-invariant spectrum by min-max and the Haar vacuum trial, with no representation cutoff. This is a separate finite-volume Hamiltonian.
scalar_vacuum_comparison: Apply standard Gaussian oscillator quantization to the published positive-frequency scalar branch at private order zero. Omit the spatial zero mode on each finite periodic box. Compare six unnormalized two-point functions and the Wick four-point sum at sites (time,x,y,z) = (0,0,0,0), (2,1,0,0), (4,0,1,0), (6,0,0,1). Cross box lengths 24 and 48 with mesh sizes 1/4 and 1/8. Publish errors against the infinite-volume conformal kernel and both limit controls. The vacuum prescription is a supplied comparison construction.
